notes:
Inbound from VP Product (Ben Morales) — looking to move from prototype to production by Q3 2026. Mid-market analytics SaaS with multi-tenant product and strict EU data residency for EU customers. Ran Hosted API POC for 8 weeks; results summarized below.

POC & technical summary: ran ~1.2B tokens across chat+rerank in POC month. Avg latency (generation) 85ms p50, p95 180-210ms at 2k rps prefix traffic; embeddings throughput 120 qps with small-batch tuning. Prefers open-model variants but willing to adopt Redwood-verified model catalog. Needs token-level cost visibility.

Commercial ask (from Ben & finance): committed baseline for Dedicated with predictable monthly unit cost, plus burst up to 2x-3x when release events occur. Initial Redwood proposal: commit = 24 A100-equivalent GPU-hrs/day (~720 GPU-hrs/mo) with 20% discount vs hosted list; burst pool to 48 GPU-hrs/day for up to 72 hours/month; overage at $0.30/GPU-hr or alternatively $0.0005/token — customer pushing for $0.20/GPU-hr cap after ramp. Wants 6-month ramp schedule: month1 40% commit usage, month2 60%, month3 80% then steady.

Security & compliance notes: requires SSO/SAML + SCIM, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, KMS integration for key management, and retention controls for PII. Legal flagged clause: "no cross-border routing of EU inference data" — Redwood asked for technical design doc.

Quotes / snippets: "We need predictable spend for GA — bursts are fine but can’t blow the budget during PR spikes." — Ben Morales, VP Product.

Commercial timeline: AE proposed draft SOW 2026-02-22 (v2). Finance scheduled pricing huddle 2026-03-04. Procurement expects final terms + PO by 2026-04-15 if legal/data residency language agreed.

Internal notes: prioritize Dedicated demo replay and SLO guarantees in deal desk. Consider adding 10% additional onboarding credits for frictionless switch from hosted to dedicated. SE to present cost modeling v2 with token vs GPU-hr comparison.
